home.title: Home Page
home.inGameHint: Go to the lobby to see game details and start playing!
home.inGameResumeHint: Press Play to resume the game
home.noGame: You are not currently in a game. Join or create a new game to get started!

setup.title: Player Setup
setup.subtitle: Complete your setup and spend all experience points to become ready.

worldEventHelp.title: World Event Details
worldEventHelp.subtitle: The world event has concluded with the following results. The most widespread biome on the map was {target}, influenced by the energy of {driver}. In the list below you can see each change that was applied.
worldEventHelp.waiting: World event not triggered yet. Waiting for someone to enter Region II.

gameNew.title: New Game
gameNew.description: Create a new game by entering a name and the maximum number of players allowed. You can always change these settings later in the lobby.

gameJoin.title: Join Game
gameJoin.description: Join an existing game by entering the game code provided by the host. Make sure to enter the code correctly to join the desired game.

gameSettings.title: Settings
gameSettings.description: Update game name and maximum number of players. You can adjust these settings from the lobby while the game is waiting.

genericDelete.title: Delete?
genericDelete.message: Are you sure you want to delete this? This action cannot be undone.

genericConfirm.title: Confirm?
genericConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to proceed? This action cannot be undone.

rulebook.title: Rulebook
rulebook.loadPageError: Unable to load the selected page.

fastTravel.title: Fast travel
fastTravel.flavorText: Sacred places call to one another... but every step has its price in coins.
fastTravel.description: Cost: 1 coin per orthogonal cell, max 15. You will arrive on the next turn.
fastTravel.routeCostInfo: Route cost is 1 coin per orthogonal cell, capped at 15.
fastTravel.noDestinations: No discovered safe-place destinations are available yet.
fastTravel.notEnoughCoinsRoute: Not enough coins for this route.
fastTravel.selectedRouteTooExpensive: Selected route costs {cost} coins, but you only have {money}.
fastTravel.confirmInfo: Confirming ends your turn and you will skip one additional turn before arrival.

spellTeleport.title: {spellName}: select destination
spellTeleport.description: Choose one explored cell within {range} orthogonal tiles.

resourceExchange.title: Resource exchange
resourceExchange.description: Exchange resources 1:1 with the village craftsman. Confirming this action ends your turn.
resourceExchange.noResources: You need at least 1 resource to perform an exchange.
resourceExchange.invalidSelection: Invalid selection. Ensure resources differ and amount is within available quantity.

levelUp.title: Level Up
levelUp.chooseOne: Choose one parameter to increase by 1.

strength.label: Strength
strength.description: Increase physical power and HP. HP increases by 5% for each point assigned.

magic.label: Magic
magic.description: Improve magical aptitude and MP. MP increases by 1 for each point assigned.

mystic.title: City Mystic
mystic.flavorText: He closes his eyes and opens his mind to the currents of fate...
mystic.offerInfo: Offer exactly {cost} coins to let the Mystic enter your mind.

errors.notEnoughCoins: You do not have enough coins to pay the Mystic.

chaos.title: Chaos
chaos.flavorText: Chaos energy is unpredictable. Nobody knows what will happen...
chaos.targetInfo: {spellName} on {targetName}. One of the following effects will be applied at random.

enchantress.title: Capital Enchantress
enchantress.flavorText: She shuffles her ancient cards and beckons you closer...
enchantress.offerInfo: Offer exactly {cost} coins to draw your fate.

jackpot.label: Arcane Jackpot
jackpot.preview: Bravery + Focus for 3 turns. On exactly 100: Toadify. On 100+: draw spell from deck.

errors.notEnoughCoins: You do not have enough coins to pay the Enchantress.

academySpellUpgrader.title: Spell Master
academySpellUpgrader.info: Choose a spell to upgrade. The base version will be removed from your spellbook.
academySpellUpgrader.noOptions: You have no spells eligible for upgrading.

errors.notEnoughCoins: You do not have enough coins for this upgrade.

info.main: Buy or sell items, then confirm your cart.
info.turnRule: Buying ends your turn. Selling does not.

doctor.maximums: Maximum by HP: {hp} | maximum by coins: {coins}

errors.notEnoughCoinsSingle: You do not have enough coins for a single treatment.
errors.notEnoughCoinsSelection: Selected treatments cost {cost} coins, but you only have {money}.

subtitle.noFreeSlot: No free slot for {resource}. Discard one resource or cancel pickup.
subtitle.selectDiscard: Select one resource stack and discard 1 unit.

wrongSpirit.label: Wrong Spirit
wrongSpirit.preview: You summon the wrong spirit, lose 10% HP, no resurrection

zombieAwakening.label: Zombie Awakening
zombieAwakening.preview: You summon a Zombie instead of the selected follower

distortedResurrection.label: Distorted Resurrection
distortedResurrection.preview: Selected follower returns as undead with 1 HP

completeResurrection.label: Complete Resurrection
completeResurrection.preview: Selected follower returns with full HP

description.activate: Activating the sanctuary grants 1 XP, binds your character to the sanctuary element and marks the sanctuary quadrant under that elemental influence.
description.donate: Donating 5 coins to an active sanctuary shifts your attunement to its element if you are currently attuned to a different one.

sanctuary.activationInfo: Activate the Sanctuary by consuming 3 MP to attune to its corresponding element and gain its associated spell. More info about attunement is available in the Rulebook.

errors.notEnoughCoins: You do not have enough coins for this action.
errors.notEnoughMp: You do not have enough MP: {cost} required.

worldEventFlow.title: World Event
worldEventFlow.notificationIntro: Target {targetBiome}, driver {driverBiome}. Each affected cell may resolve as positive, negative, or no change.

timeOfDay.title: Time
timeOfDay.helpDescription: At every round, day switches to night and vice versa. Time of day influences some items and creatures: those active during a specific time gain +1 to their parameters.

help.turnRound: A turn is the action performed by a single player. When all players have taken one turn, the round advances.
help.discovered: The map has 100 explorable tiles. Entering an undiscovered tile reveals its biome and any other point of interest on that tile.
help.activeShrines: There are four shrines linked to four elements: fire, water, wind and earth. Discovering and activating shrines lets you attune to their element and may grant bonuses. Each active shrine in Region I reduces the impact of the World Event when it is triggered.
help.worldEvent: Crossing from Region I to Region II alerts the forces of evil, triggering a counter-move that may reshape the map. The World Event targets the most revealed biome; the next biome in rank determines the possible effects. Click for more info.

commands.title: Commands
commands.empty: No actions available for this position.

errors.notKnown: You do not know this spell.
errors.notEnoughMp: Not enough MP to cast this spell.
errors.noTeleportTargets: No valid explored target is available for this spell.
errors.noCellTargets: No valid cells available for this spell.

cellSelection.label: Select cell
cellSelection.promptDestroy: Select a cell to remove its event

luck.title: Luck-meter
luck.helpDescription: A random number is often generated (while exploring, when interacting with special characters in safe places, etc.). If it reaches or exceeds 100, it triggers a Lucky Strike and the player receives a better reward. The Luck stat increases the chance of reaching 100.

cellInspector.dormantSanctuary: The sanctuary is still dormant and hidden.

water.active: A great crystal slowly spins at the center of the sanctuary, radiating a refreshing blue light. The sanctuary is active.
water.inactive: Suspended above a crystal-clear pool, a large white crystal hovers at the center of the sanctuary.

fire.active: A great crystal slowly spins at the center of the sanctuary, radiating an intense red light. The sanctuary is active.
fire.inactive: Suspended above a pool of blazing lava, a large white crystal hovers at the center of the sanctuary.

wind.active: A great crystal slowly spins at the center of the sanctuary, radiating a soothing violet light. The sanctuary is active.
wind.inactive: The sound of chimes hanging all around the sanctuary accompanies the sight of a large white crystal hovering at its center.

earth.active: A great crystal slowly spins at the center of the sanctuary, radiating a reassuring yellow light. The sanctuary is active.
earth.inactive: Framed by lush, thriving nature, a large white crystal hovers at the center of the sanctuary.

conditionDescription.hostile-environment: Inflicts HP damage per connected biome cell unless protected by an active status.
conditionDescription.regenerating-waters: Restores HP based on connected environment size, up to a capped amount.
conditionDescription.abundant-resources: Doubles resources gained from exploration and gather actions on this cell.
conditionDescription.open-ground: Allows diagonal movement from this cell.
conditionDescription.swift-path: Improves movement from this cell with enhanced traversal.
conditionDescription.vein-of-plenty: Doubles minerals gained on this cell.
conditionDescription.ancient-knowledge: Grants bonus experience when ending your turn on this cell.
conditionDescription.cursed-ground: Reduces luck-check effectiveness on this cell.
conditionDescription.enemy-level-bonus-by-region-value: Increases enemy level according to the cell's region value.

regionCrossing.title: Entering Region II
regionCrossing.message: Crossing this border may trigger a world event. Do you want to proceed?

leaveGame.title: Leave game?
leaveGame.message: You are about to leave the game. You can rejoin at any time, but if other players keep playing you will not witness their turns. They can also vote to skip your turn. Let them know if you are unavailable now.

graveyard.title: Graveyard Resurrection
graveyard.message: Choose which dead follower you want to call back from the discard pile.

temple.title: Temple Devotion
temple.message: Choose an follower to leave at the Temple. Animals, spirits and undead are not allowed.

altar.title: Altar Sacrifice
altar.message: Choose an follower to sacrifice at the Altar. Undead cannot be sacrificed.

elementalRitual.title: Elemental Ritual
elementalRitual.message: Choose a follower to transform. They will gain +1 STR, +1 MAG and at least 10 HP.

errors.noMerchantForLandmark: No merchant configured for this landmark.
errors.noDeadFollowerForResurrection: No dead follower is available for resurrection.
errors.noTempleFollower: No eligible follower is available for temple devotion.
errors.noAltarFollower: No eligible follower is available for altar sacrifice.
errors.noElementalRitualFollower: No eligible follower is available for the Elemental Ritual.

reason.pendingResourcePickup: Resolve pending resource pickup before ending your turn.
reason.passControl: Pass control to the next player.
reason.moveBeforeEnd: Move at least once before ending your turn.

effectReasons.sanctuaryQuadrantInfluence: Attuned sanctuary influence in current quadrant

horse.name: Horse
horse.description: A loyal mount. Use Feed horse before moving to gain +1 movement this turn.

princess.name: Princess
princess.description: A noble follower with arcane intuition.

mule.name: Mule
mule.description: A sturdy pack animal that increases your carrying capacity by 4.

zombie.name: Zombie
zombie.description: A shambling undead follower. Grants +1 STR, consumes 1 food each turn (or you lose 1 HP), and can be dismissed with Eliminate zombie.

cursed-rune-sword.name: Cursed Rune Sword
cursed-rune-sword.description: A sword that feeds on dark intent.

common-axe.name: Axe
common-axe.description: A basic axe for beginners. Enables Chop wood in forests.

sealed-orb.name: Sealed Orb
sealed-orb.description: A mysterious relic with latent market value.

water-bottle.name: Water Bottle
water-bottle.description: A reusable bottle that stores water charges for harsh journeys.

system.feedHorse: {playerName} fed the horse and gained +1 movement for this turn.
system.zombieUpkeepMissingFood: {playerName} had zombie upkeep missing {missingFood} food and lost {missingFood} HP.
system.inventoryOverflowDiscarded: {playerName} discarded {discardedItemsCount} item(s) due to inventory overflow after follower loss.

player.worldEventTriggered: {playerName} triggered {eventTitle}: {outcome}. Target {targetBiome}, driver {driverBiome}, active shrines in Region I: {activeShrinesInRegionI}.
player.worldEventMutationSummary: {playerName} completed World Event mutation: changed cells {cellsMutated}/{cellsAffected}.
player.activateSanctuary: {playerName} activated {sanctuaryLabel} and attuned to its element.

praySanctuary.lucky: {playerName} prayed at {sanctuary} and restored {healedHp} HP with a lucky blessing.
praySanctuary.noHeal: {playerName} prayed at {sanctuary}, but received no healing response.

player.consumeRation: {playerName} consumed a ration and gained Nutrition.
player.safePlaceHeal: {playerName} used {source}, restored {healedHp} HP and spent {spentCoins} coins.
player.capitalInn: {playerName} rested at the {source}, restored {healedHp} HP, spent {spentCoins} coins and ended the turn.
player.landmarkTraining: {playerName} trained at {source}, gained +{increasedBy} {parameter} (now {newValue}), spent {spentCoins} coins, ended the turn and will skip the next turn.
player.villageCraftsmanExchange: {playerName} exchanged {amount} {giveLabel} for {amount} {receiveLabel} at the {source} and ended the turn.
player.safePlaceWait: {playerName} waited at {place} using {source}, simulated movement on the same cell and ended the turn.
player.capitalEnchantress.spell: {playerName} consulted {source}, paid {spentCoins} coins, drew {rewardLabel} and learned the spell: {learnedSpellName}.
player.academySpellUpgrade: {playerName} upgraded {fromSpellName}→{toSpellName} at {source}, paid {spentCoins} coins and ended the turn.
player.templeSendDevotee: {playerName} sent a devotee at {source}, became GOOD and gained {gainedExperience} XP.
player.altarSacrifice: {playerName} performed a sacrifice at {source}, became EVIL and gained {gainedExperience} XP.
player.elementalRitual: {playerName} performed the Elemental Ritual at {source} on follower {followerId}.
player.eliminateZombie: {playerName} used {source} and eliminated the active zombie.
player.merchantBuy: {playerName} bought {itemName}{quantityLabel} from {source} for {spentCoins} coins and ended the turn.
player.fastTravelBooked: {playerName} booked {source} from {from} to {to}, spent {spentCoins} coins and will skip {skippedTurns} {turnLabel} before arriving.
player.hostileEnvironmentDamage: {playerName} suffered {damageHp} HP from hostile desert (environment size {environmentSize}).
player.regeneratingWatersHealing: {playerName} healed {healingHp} HP from regenerating waters (environment size {environmentSize}).
player.followerHostileEnvironmentDamage: {playerName}'s follower {followerName} suffered {damageHp} HP from hostile desert (environment size {environmentSize}).
player.followerRegeneratingWatersHealing: {playerName}'s follower {followerName} healed {healingHp} HP from regenerating waters (environment size {environmentSize}).
player.castSpellHeal: {playerName} cast {spellName}, healed {healedHp} HP and spent {spentMp} MP.

player.castSpellTeleport: {playerName} cast {spellName}, teleported to {targetX}, {targetY} and spent {spentMp} MP.
player.castSpellTransform: {playerName} cast {spellName}, transformed cell {x}, {y} into {biome} and spent {spentMp} MP.

player.castSpellAlchemy: {playerName} cast {spellName}: alchemized item {itemId} for {goldValue} coins (−{spentMp} MP).
player.castSpellDestroy: {playerName} cast {spellName} and removed an event from cell ({targetX},{targetY}) (−{spentMp} MP).
player.castSpellBlockAllSpells: {playerName} cast {spellName}: all players silenced for {durationTurns} turns (−{spentMp} MP).
player.castSpellRecall: {playerName} cast {spellName} and teleported to their sanctuary (−{spentMp} MP).
player.castSpellGainCoins: {playerName} cast {spellName}, gained {coinsGained} coins and spent {spentMp} MP.
player.castSpellPurify: {playerName} cast {spellName}, removed {removedCount} negative statuses and spent {spentMp} MP.
player.castSpellCounterPending: {playerName} cast {spellName} on {targetPlayerName} — awaiting counter-spell response (−{spentMp} MP).

activateSanctuary.label: Activate
activateSanctuary.description: Infuse your magic into {sanctuaryLabel} to activate it and attune to it.

sanctuary.label: Sanctuary
sanctuary.description: Open {sanctuaryLabel} and choose one of its available actions.

donateSanctuary.label: Donate
donateSanctuary.description: Donate 5 coins to a Sanctuary Guardian so they can perform the attunement rite with element {elementLabel}. Gain attunement with {elementLabel}.

praySanctuary.label: Pray
praySanctuary.description: If your prayer is accepted, recover 5% HP, or 10% with a Lucky Strike. Your turn ends.

cellGather.label: Gather
cellGather.description: Spend 1 food to forage this biome, gain 1 resource, then end your turn.

chopTree.label: Chop wood
chopTree.description: Use your axe in a forest to gain 1 timber, then end your turn.

consumeRation.label: Consume ration
consumeRation.description: Spend 1 food to gain Nutrition until end of turn and ignore hostile desert damage.

feedHorse.label: Feed horse
feedHorse.description: Spend 1 food before moving to gain +1 movement range this turn.

safePlaceWait.label: Wait
safePlaceWait.description: Safe place: simulate movement on your current cell and end the turn without cost.

fastTravel.label: Fast travel
fastTravel.description: Safe place: travel to a discovered safe place. Cost 1 coin per orthogonal cell (max 15), then end turn and skip your next turn.

campGatherer.label: Gatherer
campGatherer.description: Camp: gain 1 timber and 1 minerals, then end turn.

warning.capacity: Not enough inventory capacity: need {requiredSlots} free slots, available {availableSlots}.

campHunter.label: Hunter
campHunter.description: Camp: gain 1 food and 1 cloth, then end turn.

warning.capacity: Not enough inventory capacity: need {requiredSlots} free slots, available {availableSlots}.

capitalDoctor.label: Doctor
capitalDoctor.description: Visit the Capital Doctor: each treatment restores 5% HP and costs {costPerUnit} coins ({timeOfDay}). Then end your turn.

capitalEnchantress.label: Enchantress
capitalEnchantress.description: Consult the Capital Enchantress for 5 coins. Draw your fate from a luck check, then end your turn.

cityHealer.label: Healer
cityHealer.description: Visit the City Healer: each treatment restores 5% HP and costs {costPerUnit} coins ({timeOfDay}). Then end your turn.

cityMystic.label: Mystic
cityMystic.description: Consult the City Mystic for 5 coins. Draw your fate from a luck check, then end your turn.

cityMerchant.label: Merchant
cityMerchant.description: Visit the City Merchant. Buy or sell items from a configurable stock. Buying ends your turn.

capitalInn.label: Inn
capitalInn.description: Rest at the Capital Inn: restore 50% HP, pay 10 coins, then end your turn (day only).

castleRest.label: Rest
castleRest.description: Rest at the Castle: restore 50% HP, pay 10 coins, then end your turn (day and night).

castleTrainer.label: Trainer
castleTrainer.description: Train Strength at the Castle. Cost {trainingCost} coins (3 x level), gain +1 permanent STR, end your turn and skip your next one.

academyTrainer.label: Trainer
academyTrainer.description: Train Magic at the Academy. Cost {trainingCost} coins (3 x level), gain +1 permanent MAG, end your turn and skip your next one.

academyMerchant.label: Arcane Merchant
academyMerchant.description: Visit the Academy Merchant. Buy magical stock and sell only magical items. Buying ends your turn.

academySpellUpgrader.label: Spell Master
academySpellUpgrader.description: Upgrade Mimicry→Mimicry+ or Negate→Negate+ for 12 coins. Ends your turn.

manorCounterfeiter.label: Arcane Counterfeiter
manorCounterfeiter.description: Visit the Arcane Counterfeiter at the Manor. Buy from a shady stock. Buying ends your turn.

villageCraftsman.label: Craftsman
villageCraftsman.description: Trade resources 1:1 at the Village Craftsman, then end your turn.

graveyardResurrect.label: Resurrect
graveyardResurrect.description: Attempt to resurrect a dead follower from your discard pile through a luck check. Outcomes may be dangerous.

templeSendDevotee.label: Send devotee
templeSendDevotee.description: Leave an eligible follower at the Temple. Your alignment becomes good, gain 2 XP, then end turn.

altarSacrifice.label: Sacrifice
altarSacrifice.description: Sacrifice an eligible follower at the Altar. Your alignment becomes evil, gain 2 XP, then end turn.

elementalRitual.label: Elemental Ritual
elementalRitual.description: Transform a follower into their elemental form. Requires elemental affinity. Grants +1 STR, +1 MAG and at least 10 HP. Only usable while you have no already upgraded follower. End turn.

eliminateZombie.label: Eliminate zombie
eliminateZombie.description: Destroy your zombie companion and end your turn.

fly.name: Fly
fly.description: Enables diagonal movement for this turn. Must be cast before moving.

innerFire.name: Inner Fire
innerFire.description: Apply Bravery to yourself for 1 turn. Increases Strength by 1.

reinvigorate.name: Reinvigorate
reinvigorate.description: Restore HP equal to your current Magic value.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.description: Move to any explored cell within {range} orthogonal steps. Cannot move again this turn.

empower.name: Empower
empower.description: Add your Magic to your Strength for the duration of this combat.

chaos.name: Chaos
chaos.description: Choose a target player. They make a luck check with a random outcome: gain or lose HP, coins, or a status effect.

filch.name: Filch
filch.description: Steal 10 coins from a target player on a luck check of 70 or more.

alchemy.name: Alchemy
alchemy.description: Convert an item you own into its coin value.

immobilize.name: Immobilize
immobilize.description: Apply Immobilized to a target player for 1 turn.

dispel.name: Dispel
dispel.description: Remove one negative status from yourself.

fortune.name: Fortune
fortune.description: Apply Fortune to yourself for 1 turn.

focus.name: Focus
focus.description: Apply Focus to yourself for 1 turn.

scout.name: Scout
scout.description: Reveal an unexplored cell within {range} orthogonal steps.

safePassage.name: Safe Passage
safePassage.description: Ignore the next environmental hazard or negative cell effect when entering a cell.

fateRead.name: Fate Reading
fateRead.description: Preview the next 2 local events that could be drawn or resolved.

transmute.name: Transmute
transmute.description: Transform 1 common resource into a different common resource.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.description: Preview the next 2 local events. Order is not changed.

mesmerize.name: Mesmerize
mesmerize.description: Steal a follower from a target player on a luck check of 70 or more.

curse.name: Curse
curse.description: Apply Hexed and Weakened to a target player for 3 turns.

petrify.name: Petrify
petrify.description: A target player skips their next turn.

purify.name: Purify
purify.description: Remove all negative statuses from yourself.

recall.name: Recall
recall.description: Return to your last visited or activated sanctuary. Cannot move further this turn.

minorExile.name: Minor Exile
minorExile.description: Remove a negative follower from your party.

divination.name: Divination
divination.description: Preview the next 5 local events. Order is not changed.

spellBreak.name: Spell Break
spellBreak.description: No player, including you, can cast spells until the end of the next round.

destroy.name: Destroy
destroy.description: Remove a temporary or permanent local event from a visible cell. Cannot remove landmarks, sanctuaries, bosses, or mission objectives.

counterspell.name: Counterspell
counterspell.description: Cancel a hostile spell targeting you at the moment it is cast. Cannot cancel already-resolved effects.

timeFold.name: Time Fold
timeFold.description: Make up to 2 consecutive moves before resolving events or combat. You cannot attack players, cast other spells, or collect resources during these moves.

mimicry.name: Mimicry
mimicry.description: Copy a random spell from a target player and learn it.

mimicryPlus.name: Mimicry+
mimicryPlus.description: Copy a spell of your choice from a target player and learn it.

negate.name: Negate
negate.description: Make a target player forget a random spell.

negatePlus.name: Negate+
negatePlus.description: Make a target player forget a spell of your choice.

silence.name: Silence
silence.description: Apply Silence to a target player for 3 turns.

manaShield.name: Mana Shield
manaShield.description: Reduce the next damage you take by consuming remaining MP.

manaDrain.name: Mana Drain
manaDrain.description: Steal 1 MP from a target player and recover 1 MP on a luck check of 70 or more.

seal.name: Seal
seal.description: The next hostile spell targeting you has no effect.

disciple.name: Disciple
disciple.description: When another player gains Strength or Magic through level-up or permanent reward, you gain +1 to the same stat.

elementalBond.name: Elemental Bond
elementalBond.description: Temporarily change your elemental attunement to a chosen element for 1 turn.

toadify.name: Toadify
toadify.description: Apply Minified to a target player for 2 turns on a luck check of 70 or more.

nutrition.label: Nutrition
nutrition.description: Prevents hostile environment damage for this turn.

poison.label: Poison
poison.description: Takes damage at the end of each turn.

regen.label: Regen
regen.description: Heals a small amount at the end of each turn.

minified.label: Minified
minified.description: Transforms the target into a mouse. Primary stats are set to 1, HP/MP recovery is disabled, and item use is blocked.

silence.label: Silence
silence.description: Spell casting and MP natural regeneration are disabled.

fortune.label: Fortune
fortune.description: Doubles the luck bonus applied to luck checks.

invisibility.label: Invisibility
invisibility.description: You cannot be attacked or targeted by spells.

flying.label: Flying
flying.description: You can move diagonally while this status is active.

empowered.label: Empowered
empowered.description: Magic is added to Strength in combat.

safeStep.label: Safe Step
safeStep.description: The next harmful cell or environment effect is ignored.

manaShield.label: Mana Shield
manaShield.description: The next incoming damage can be reduced by spending remaining MP.

spellWard.label: Spell Ward
spellWard.description: The next hostile spell targeting you is negated.

petrified.label: Petrified
petrified.description: You are turned to stone and skip your next turn.

anchored.label: Anchored
anchored.description: You cannot move while this status is active.

fateSight.label: Fate Sight
fateSight.description: You can glimpse the next relevant random outcome.

zombified.label: Zombified
zombified.description: Raised by dark rites and bound to your service for a short time.
